meta.name: airbnb-search-listing
meta.description: Extracts Airbnb accommodation search results from a destination query via SSR-embedded data, returning listing ID, URL, name, coordinates, rating, price, photos, and badge info for each result, plus pagination cursors for multi-page retrieval. Use when user mentions Airbnb search results, Airbnb listings, vacation rental search, short-term rental listings, scrape Airbnb, get Airbnb data, find rentals on Airbnb, Airbnb destination search, Airbnb property list, Airbnb stays search, Airbnb accommodation results, pull Airbnb listings, collect Airbnb search data, Airbnb scraper, Airbnb search page extraction, Airbnb search by destination.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取爱彼迎搜索结果中的房源信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取爱彼迎房源数据用于市场分析或比价。
copy.tagline_en: Extract Airbnb listing details from search results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk collect Airbnb listing data for market analysis or price comparison.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的目的地，从 Airbnb 搜索页面提取房源列表，返回每个房源的 ID、链接、名称、坐标、评分、价格、照片和标签，并支持翻页获取更多结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Airbnb 搜索、房源列表、短租查询等关键词，或要求获取 Airbnb 上的住宿数据时触发。

say.text: 提取伦敦 Airbnb 搜索结果，价格上限 200 美元，最少 2 间卧室。
say.note: 会按筛选条件返回房源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract Airbnb listing results from a search page based on your destination, returning each listing's ID, URL, name, coordinates, rating, price, photos, and badges, with pagination support for more results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Airbnb search, listings, vacation rental search, or similar keywords, or ask to get Airbnb data.

say_en.text: Search Airbnb listings in Paris, check-in June 1, check-out June 5, 2 adults.
Extract London Airbnb results, max price $200, at least 2 bedrooms.
